newsitem.title: USA: Continental Choice Care holders okay sale.
newsitem.headline: Continental Choice Care holders okay sale.

text.p: Continental Choice Care Inc said Friday its shareholders have approved the sale of substantially all of the assets of Continental and certain of its subsidiaries to IHS of New York Inc.
Terms of the sale were not disclosed.

The company said the sale agreement was amended on May 23. The amendment provides for the sale to privately owned IHS of New York of the assets of Continental and certain of its subsidiaries and consulting customers separately from or without regard to the sale of Upper Manhattan Dialysis Center Inc to IHS of New York.
